hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push'; then branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ] && ! gh pr view "$branch" --json number >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh pr create --fill --base main --head "$branch" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi
